elements.name: ripple
elements.description: Enables or disables the ripple effect. It is enabled by default, except for the transparent variant.

accessibility.general: The Button component is accessible by default. It uses the native button element, which is focusable and supports keyboard interactions.
elements: If you don't put text in the button, you should add an aria-label to describe the button's action.
When the loading prop is set to true, the button is disabled and aria-busy="true" is added.
When the pressed prop is set to true, aria-pressed="true" is added to the button.
